title: Rethinking What to Cache in Few-Step Diffusion Transformers: Solver-Aware Target Selection
title_zh: 重新思考少步扩散Transformer中应缓存的内容：基于求解器的目标选择

paragraphs.en: Even after step distillation shortens DiT sampling ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) , each remaining forward pass in image and video generation is costly ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) . Caching can skip some of those passes ( Ma et al., 2024b ; Kahatapitiya et al., 2025 ) , but the larger gaps between the remaining solver steps make a tensor computed at one step less reliable when it is reused at a later step.
paragraphs.zh: 即使经过步骤蒸馏缩短了 DiT 采样（Salimans 和 Ho，2022；Song 等，2023；Luo 等，2023），图像和视频生成中每次剩余的前向传播仍然成本高昂（Chen 等，2024b；Team Wan 等，2025；Kong 等，2024）。 缓存可以跳过其中一些前向传播（Ma 等，2024b；Kahatapitiya 等，2025），但剩余求解步骤之间的间隔越大，某一步骤中计算的张量在后续步骤中被重复使用时，其可靠性就越低。

paragraphs.en: Many cache methods decide when to reuse a tensor or predict how a stored feature should change, but keep the tensor type fixed. Different types can produce different sampling trajectories. For a given model, solver, and reuse schedule, which tensor should we cache?

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the distinction between caching a value inside the DiT and caching one of its outputs for the solver. We study the second case. At a reuse step, the stored output is used with a new latent and solver step size. For a linear-flow model using Euler sampling, a DiT prediction can be stored as a velocity (the latent’s rate of change along the sampling path), a clean endpoint (the estimated noise-free latent), or a one-step update (the velocity multiplied by that step’s size). These forms describe the same prediction at the exact step, but need not behave alike when reused later. Velocity and the clean endpoint give the same trajectory if the endpoint is converted at each new step. A stored update, however, retains the earlier step size and can produce a different trajectory when that size changes. This is why the solver must be part of the cache-target comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了在 DiT 内部缓存一个值与为求解器缓存其输出之一之间的区别。 我们研究第二种情况。 在重用步骤中，存储的输出会与新的潜变量和求解器步长一起使用。 对于采用欧拉采样的线性流模型，DiT 的预测可以存储为速度（潜变量沿采样路径的变化率）、干净的终点（估计的无噪声潜变量）或一步更新（速度乘以该步的步长）。 这些形式描述了同一精确步骤下的相同预测，但在后续重用时未必表现一致。 如果每个新步骤都将终点进行转换，那么速度和干净的终点将给出相同的轨迹。 然而，存储的更新会保留之前的步长，当该步长发生变化时，可能会产生不同的轨迹。 这就是为什么求解器必须成为缓存目标比较的一部分。

paragraphs.en: With the reuse steps fixed, AutoTarget chooses what to cache using a few uncached sampling runs. Each run evaluates the DiT at every scheduled step, allowing us to measure the local reuse error of every valid target. Because the candidates represent different quantities, we pass each one through its solver conversion and the frozen VAE decoder before comparing it with the uncached run. If the two lowest errors are too close, AutoTarget makes no selection. Otherwise, deployment uses the target with the lowest calibration error. This selection requires no training and adds no inference-time predictor. All candidates use the same number of DiT evaluations and the same solver sequence for a fair comparison. Figure 4 shows the calibration and deployment stages.
paragraphs.zh: 在重用步骤固定的情况下，AutoTarget 通过几次未缓存的采样运行来选择要缓存的内容。 每次运行都会在每个预定步骤中评估 DiT，从而使我们能够测量每个有效目标的局部重用误差。 由于候选项代表不同的量，我们在进行比较之前，会先将每个候选项通过其求解器转换和冻结的 VAE 解码器处理，再与未缓存的运行结果进行比较。 如果两个最小的误差过于接近，AutoTarget 将不作选择。 否则，部署时将使用校准误差最低的目标。 这种选择无需训练，也不会增加推理时的预测模型。 为了公平比较，所有候选项都使用相同数量的 DiT 评估和相同的求解器序列。 图 4 展示了校准和部署阶段。

paragraphs.en: Modern DiT pipelines build on denoising diffusion and score-based modeling ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021b ) , latent-space generation ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , and transformer denoisers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) . These foundations make the repeated transformer forward pass the main unit targeted by both step reduction and cache reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 现代 DiT 流程建立在去噪扩散和基于得分的建模（Ho 等人，2020；Song 等人，2021b）、潜在空间生成（Rombach 等人，2022）以及 Transformer 去噪器（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）的基础之上。 这些基础使得重复的 Transformer 前向传播成为步骤减少和缓存重用共同针对的主要单元。

paragraphs.en: Few-Step Distillation of Diffusion Models. Step distillation compresses the iterative reverse process of diffusion models into a small number of sampling steps, through progressive distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) , consistency training ( Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) , and distribution-matching or adversarial objectives ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Sauer et al., 2024 ) . These recipes yield the distilled image and video DiTs studied in this work, including PixArt- δ \delta ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024a ) , FLUX.1-schnell ( Black Forest Labs, 2024b ) , and distilled variants of Wan and HunyuanVideo ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) . Distillation increases the gap between adjacent solver coordinates. This makes reuse errors more likely to change the solver trajectory, even though skipping one DiT evaluation still saves substantial computation ( Du et al., 2025 ) . AutoTarget works with a frozen distilled model and chooses the tensor to cache.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型的少步蒸馏。 步数蒸馏通过渐进式蒸馏（Salimans 和 Ho，2022）、一致性训练（Song 等，2023；Luo 等，2023）以及分布匹配或对抗性目标（Yin 等，2024b；Yin 等，2024a；Sauer 等，2024），将扩散模型的迭代反向过程压缩为少量采样步。 这些方法生成了本研究中所探讨的蒸馏图像和视频 DiT，包括 PixArt-δ \delta（Chen 等，2024b；Chen 等，2024a）、FLUX.1-schnell（Black Forest Labs，2024b），以及 Wan 和 HunyuanVideo 的蒸馏变体（Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2025；Team Wan 等，2025；Kong 等，2024）。 蒸馏会增大相邻求解器坐标之间的差距。 这使得重复利用错误更有可能改变求解器轨迹，尽管跳过一次 DiT 评估仍能节省大量计算资源（Du 等，2025）。 AutoTarget 与一个已冻结的蒸馏模型协同工作，并选择需要缓存的张量。

paragraphs.en: Caching and Feature Reuse. Caching methods skip full network evaluations by reusing tensors computed at earlier solver coordinates. Most methods cache predefined internal representations: deep or block features ( Ma et al., 2024b ; Wimbauer et al., 2024 ) , layer outputs with learned skip routers ( Ma et al., 2024a ) , fast-forwarded blocks ( Selvaraju et al., 2024 ) , polynomially reconstructed features ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , attention results ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) , or non-salient token features ( Zou et al., 2025 ) ; others adapt when to reuse via content-adaptive or timestep-embedding signals ( Kahatapitiya et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) . Under the larger inter-step gaps of distilled models, some additionally train predictors that forecast stale cached features ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Zou et al., 2026 ) . Across these methods, the cached representation itself is fixed by design.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存与特征复用。 缓存方法通过复用先前求解器坐标处计算出的张量，跳过完整的网络评估。 大多数方法会缓存预定义的内部表示：深度或块特征（Ma et al., 2024b；Wimbauer et al., 2024）、带有可学习跳跃路由器的层输出（Ma et al., 2024a）、快速前传块（Selvaraju et al., 2024）、多项式重构特征（Feng et al., 2025）、注意力结果（Zhao et al., 2025；Lyu et al., 2025）或非显著词元特征（Zou et al., 2025）；其他方法则通过内容自适应或时间步嵌入信号来动态调整复用时机（Kahatapitiya et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025a）。 在蒸馏模型较大的步骤间间隔下，一些方法还会训练预测器，以预测过时的缓存特征（Liu et al., 2025b；Zou et al., 2026）。 在这些方法中，缓存表示本身是设计时就固定的。

paragraphs.en: Cache Target Selection. A few recent methods make the cache policy more flexible. They let the model choose internal features ( Bu et al., 2026 ) , assign a reuse solver to each feature dimension ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , profile reusable blocks ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , or optimize the reuse schedule over a full trajectory ( Chu et al., 2025 ; Lei et al., 2026 ) . We study a different choice: which tensor passed to the sampling solver should be cached. The candidates include velocity, clean and noise endpoints, and solver displacement. AutoTarget groups candidates with the same solver transitions, then measures local reuse error for each remaining candidate on exact calibration runs. The chosen target depends on the model, resolution, and solver; no predictor is trained.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存目标选择。 一些近期的方法使缓存策略更加灵活。 它们允许模型选择内部特征（Bu 等，2026），为每个特征维度分配一个重用求解器（Zheng 等，2026），分析可重用模块（Ma 等，2025），或在完整轨迹上优化重用调度（Chu 等，2025；Lei 等，2026）。 我们研究一种不同的选择：传递给采样求解器的哪个张量应该被缓存。 候选项包括速度、干净端点和噪声端点，以及求解器位移。 AutoTarget 将具有相同求解器转换的候选项分组，然后在精确校准运行中测量每个剩余候选项的局部重用误差。 所选目标取决于模型、分辨率和求解器；无需训练任何预测器。

sents.en: Cache Target Selection.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AutoTarget on few-step image and video DiTs: FLUX.1-schnell, PixArt-LCM, and a distilled 20-step HunyuanVideo model. Within each few-step model comparison, methods use the same weights, solver, sampling coordinates, precision, prompts, and seeds. AutoTarget’s candidate targets share a fixed schedule of full DiT evaluations; baseline methods follow their own reuse rules, so their DiT call counts can differ.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate task quality using ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , while PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and decoded RGB error measure similarity to a paired reference. Each cached sample and its reference use the same prompt and initial noise, controlling these two sources of variation across paired outputs. For FLUX, the reference is the paired 50-step FLUX.1-dev output ( Black Forest Labs, 2024a ) . For PixArt-LCM, it is the paired four-step output without caching. Held-out paired comparisons report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 ImageReward（Xu 等人，2023）、CLIP（Radford 等人，2021）和 VBench（Huang 等人，2024）来评估任务质量，而 PSNR、SSIM（Wang 等人，2004）和解码后的 RGB 误差则用于衡量与配对参考图像之间的相似性。 每个缓存样本及其参考图像均使用相同的提示词和初始噪声，从而在配对输出中控制这两个变量来源。 对于 FLUX，其参考图像是配对的 50 步 FLUX.1-dev 输出（Black Forest Labs，2024a）。 对于 PixArt-LCM，其参考图像是不使用缓存的配对四步输出。 保留的配对比较报告了 95% 的自助法置信区间。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows the effect of reducing FLUX.1-dev from 50 to 17 steps: 17 steps yield 2.67 × 2.67\times speedup but reduce ImageReward from 0.985 to 0.912 and SSIM from 1.0000 to 0.6723. On four-step FLUX.1-schnell, AutoTarget generates an image in 1.120 seconds with 27.641 dB PSNR and 0.6743 SSIM. Because FLUX.1-schnell is a separate distilled checkpoint, its 16.00 × 16.00\times overall speedup uses 50-step FLUX.1-dev as the reference. Compared with four-step FLUX.1-schnell without caching, the speedup due to the cache is 1.289 × 1.289\times . AutoTarget also obtains ImageReward 0.886 and CLIP 28.376. HiCache obtains a slightly higher ImageReward of 0.896, while AutoTarget has lower latency and higher PSNR and SSIM, illustrating the different trade-offs between speed, task quality, and reference fidelity.

paragraphs.en: To test whether selection depends on the calibration set, we draw subsets of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 prompts from 32 recorded calibration runs and recompute the ranking on 1,000 sampled subsets per size. Thus, a small calibration set consistently identifies the same target in this configuration, even as the prompt subset changes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验选择是否依赖于校准集，我们从 32 次已记录的校准运行中抽取包含 1、2、4、8、16 和 32 个提示词的子集，并对每种规模的 1,000 个采样子集重新计算排名。 每次试验都选择去噪后/干净的版本，该版本在 200 个提示词的对比中也具有最高的 PSNR。 因此，在这种配置下，即使提示词子集发生变化，较小的校准集也能始终识别出相同的目标。

sents.en: Every trial selects denoised/clean, which also has the highest PSNR in the 200-prompt comparison.
sents.zh: 每次试验都选择去噪后/干净的版本，该版本在 200 个提示词的对比中也具有最高的 PSNR。

sents.en: Thus, a small calibration set consistently identifies the same target in this configuration, even as the prompt subset changes.

paragraphs.en: For further validation, Appendix D.1 reports held-out rankings and calibration errors, together with reduced-step controls, baseline threshold sweeps, and a comparison of two solvers.

paragraphs.en: AutoTarget selects a cache target for a fixed schedule of full DiT evaluations. Changing only PixArt’s image resolution reverses the ranking of velocity and denoised/clean, while the solver comparison changes which candidates are valid and the order of the lower-ranked targets. These results show that the preferred target depends on the sampling configuration, even when the candidate tensors are derived from the same model prediction.
paragraphs.zh: AutoTarget 为固定的完整 DiT 评估计划选择一个缓存目标。 仅更改 PixArt 的图像分辨率会反转速度以及去噪/干净结果的排名，而求解器比较则会改变哪些候选项有效以及排名较低的目标的顺序。 这些结果表明，首选目标取决于采样配置，即使候选张量来自相同的模型预测。

paragraphs.en: Decoded calibration error provides an empirical ranking whose reliability must be tested on held-out prompts. The solver-state bound explains error propagation, but does not establish that this ranking transfers to other prompt distributions. We therefore fix the selection rule before held-out evaluation and compare complete cached runs, where errors accumulate across reuse steps. Recalibration is required when the model, solver, schedule, or precision changes, and each candidate must have a valid conversion to the solver input. Once calibration is complete, deployment retains only the accepted tensor and requires no candidate comparisons, external quality model, or learned predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 解码后的校准误差提供了一个经验性排名，其可靠性必须在预留提示语集上进行验证。 求解器状态边界可以解释误差传播机制，但并未证明该排名能够迁移到其他提示语分布中。 因此，我们在预留评估之前固定选择规则，并比较完整的缓存运行过程，其中误差会在重复使用步骤中累积。 当模型、求解器、调度方案或精度发生变化时，需要进行重新校准，且每个候选方案都必须能合法地转换为求解器的输入。 校准完成后，部署过程仅保留被接受的张量，无需进行候选方案比较、使用外部质量模型或已学习的预测器。

paragraphs.en: The shifted LTX-Video setting ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ) illustrates why the acceptance rule is needed. Here, γ = 1.004 \gamma=1.004 , and the calibration winner outperforms the alternative on only 55% of held-out prompts. Always deploying this target incurs 7.36% regret relative to the best target for each prompt. Because the risk ratio falls below the fixed 1.10 threshold, AutoTarget abstains, allowing the application to retain uncached sampling or a previously validated cache policy when calibration does not clearly separate the candidates.
paragraphs.zh: HaCohen 等人（2024）提出的 LTX-Video 变体设置说明了为何需要接受规则。 此处 γ = 1.004，且校准获胜智能体在仅 55% 的预留提示上优于替代方案。 始终部署此目标会导致相对于每个提示的最佳目标产生 7.36% 的遗憾。 由于风险比低于固定的 1.10 阈值，AutoTarget 会放弃选择；当校准无法明确区分候选方案时，应用程序便可保留未缓存的采样方式或先前验证过的缓存策略。

paragraphs.en: We presented AutoTarget, a method for selecting which tensor to cache in few-step diffusion transformers. Given a fixed reuse schedule, it compares candidate targets using uncached sampling runs and deploys the lowest-risk target when calibration clearly separates it from the runner-up. This procedure requires no learned predictor and accounts for how the stored tensor is converted and used by the solver. Our analysis identifies equivalent targets under Euler sampling and relates local reuse errors to their accumulation along the sampling trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AutoTarget，一种用于在少步扩散变换器中选择缓存哪个张量的方法。 在给定的固定重用计划下，该方法通过未缓存的采样运行比较候选目标，并在校准结果能明确区分出风险最低的目标与次优目标时部署该目标。 此过程无需任何学习到的预测模型，并考虑了所存储张量被求解器转换和使用的具体方式。 我们的分析确定了在欧拉采样下等效的目标，并将局部重用误差与其沿采样轨迹的累积情况联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on distilled image and video models show that the preferred target changes with the sampling configuration. Target selection provides additional acceleration over uncached few-step sampling with a small cache. Paired evaluations distinguish reference fidelity from task quality, while held-out tests assess calibration rankings during complete cached runs. When candidates are insufficiently separated, AutoTarget declines to select a target, leaving the fallback policy to the application. These results support treating the cached tensor as an explicit design choice alongside the reuse schedule, guided by calibration for the intended model and solver.
paragraphs.zh: 在蒸馏图像和视频模型上进行的实验表明，首选目标会随着采样配置的变化而改变。 与使用小型缓存的无缓存少步采样相比，目标选择可提供额外的加速效果。 成对评估能够区分参考保真度与任务质量，而预留测试则用于评估完整缓存运行过程中的校准排名。 当候选项之间的差异不足时，AutoTarget 将拒绝选择目标，并将回退策略交由应用程序处理。 这些结果支持将缓存张量视为与重用计划并列的显式设计选择，其决策应依据针对目标模型和求解器的校准结果进行引导。

paragraphs.en: At every anchor step, the pipeline provides the model prediction used by the solver. AutoTarget converts this prediction into the cache targets supported by the current parameterization. In the controlled Euler example, the candidates are velocity, the clean endpoint x clean x^{\mathrm{clean}} , and the noise endpoint ε \varepsilon . Another pipeline may also provide a solver update or another tensor with the same shape as the model output. When candidates are compared under an equal storage budget, they use the same data type and tensor shape.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个锚点步骤中，流程都会向求解器提供模型预测结果。 AutoTarget 会将该预测结果转换为当前参数化所支持的缓存目标。 在受控的欧拉示例中，候选项包括速度、干净的端点 x clean x^{\mathrm{clean}} 以及噪声端点 ε \varepsilon 。 另一个流程也可以提供一个求解器更新，或一个与模型输出形状相同的张量。 当候选项在相同的存储预算下进行比较时，它们会使用相同的数据类型和张量形状。

paragraphs.en: For each calibration prompt, an exact run records the latent, model prediction, coordinate, and solver state at every step. At a reuse step, every candidate is decoded from the same anchor and receives the same exact current state. The original solver then converts the candidate into the next latent, or into the intermediate latent expected by the pipeline. This procedure compares all candidates at the same point in the computation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个校准提示，一次精确运行会记录每一步的潜在状态、模型预测、坐标和求解器状态。 在重用步骤中，每个候选项都从相同的锚点解码，并接收到完全相同的当前状态。 原始求解器随后将候选项转换为下一个潜在状态，或转换为流程所期望的中间潜在状态。 该过程在同一计算节点上比较所有候选项。

paragraphs.en: For PixArt-LCM, the boundary-conditioned denoised prediction and predicted clean endpoint are grouped only if their BF16 one-reuse terminal latents have relative L 2 L_{2} difference at most 10 − 6 10^{-6} and their decoded RGB mean squared error is at most 10 − 10 10^{-10} on every calibration trace. These tolerances were fixed before calibration. Otherwise, both remain separate candidates. The denoised prediction represents the group when the checks pass.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 PixArt-LCM，仅当边界条件约束的去噪预测与预测的干净终点的 BF16 单次复用终端潜在表示的相对 L₂ L_{2} 差异最多为 10^{-6}，且它们在每个校准轨迹上的解码 RGB 均方误差最多为 10^{-10} 时，才会被归为一组。 这些容限在校准前就已固定。 否则，两者将保持为独立的候选项。 如果检查通过，则去噪预测代表该组。

paragraphs.en: During deployment, the steps assigned to full DiT evaluation compute a new prediction and refresh the selected tensor. At a reuse step, the selected decoder reads that tensor and the original solver performs its usual transition. Deployment contains no branches over candidates, external quality model, or learned predictor. For a calibration set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and T T sampling steps, the exact runs require | 𝒫 | ​ T |\mathcal{P}|T DiT evaluations. paragraphs.en: The general analysis applies to a discrete sampling solver when its transition on the complete state satisfies the local stability condition in Eq. ( 27 ). For Euler sampling with the linear-flow parameterization, we give a closed-form proof of which targets are equivalent. For other solvers, AutoTarget can construct and compare candidates in the same way, but their ranking must be measured from that solver’s transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 当离散采样求解器在完整状态上的转移满足方程 (27) 中的局部稳定性条件时，该通用分析同样适用。 对于采用线性流参数化的欧拉采样方法，我们给出了哪些目标等价的闭式证明。 对于其他求解器，AutoTarget 可以以相同方式构建并比较候选目标，但它们的排序必须基于该求解器的转移进行衡量。

paragraphs.en: The calibration error applies to the tested model, solver, coordinate sequence, and reuse schedule. It does not guarantee the same ranking after any of these choices changes or on every prompt distribution. The decoded VAE error is the score used to compare targets in practice. The theoretical bound measures error in a state that also contains the cache and solver history. Our empirical and theoretical claims concern these two different quantities.
paragraphs.zh: 校准误差适用于所测试的模型、求解器、坐标序列和重用计划。 它并不保证在这些选项中的任何一个发生变化后，或在每种提示分布下都能保持相同的排名。 解码后的 VAE 误差是实际中用于比较目标得分的指标。 理论界限衡量的是包含缓存和求解器历史记录的状态中的误差。 我们的经验性和理论性论断涉及这两个不同的量。

paragraphs.en: Cache reuse and step removal are different operations. In our control, both methods run the DiT at the same anchor steps. They use the same number of DiT evaluations. Cache reuse still executes every transition in the original four-step solver sequence. The reduced-step run executes the solver only at the anchors. Their fidelity is nearly equal for the tested anchors. By comparison, the standard three-step PixArt-LCM schedule is much less faithful to the four-step reference. These results apply only to the tested schedules and solvers.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存重用和步骤移除是两种不同的操作。 在我们的控制下，这两种方法都在相同的锚点步骤上运行 DiT。 它们使用的 DiT 评估次数相同。 缓存重用仍然会执行原始四步求解器序列中的每个转换。 简化步骤的运行仅在锚点处执行求解器。 对于测试的锚点，它们的保真度几乎相等。 相比之下，标准的三步 PixArt-LCM 调度对四步参考的保真度要低得多。 这些结果仅适用于所测试的调度和求解器。
